scope: R5 marine mammals; full R6 routes, equipment/FP/save-load/performance/GLES and all-61 reproducibility remain pending

manatee.reviewed_by: Codex: direct native view/motion/icon, real-world land/water, original native baseline and equal-scale comparisons; not user sign-off
manatee.notes: Own anatomy, surface atlas and named motion; no baseline mesh/pixels copied. Every required original clip retained. True exported skinning tests verify vertical manatee paddle versus lateral seal hind-flipper propulsion, no loop seams, contact and coincident moving neck vertices. Gameplay bounds/speeds/habitat unchanged; manatee visual Swim corrected from idle to fly. Full native and actual 64px icons directly reviewed, plus real-water manatee and seal land/water views. Seal close-water camera was occluded by foreground terrain; discarded for acceptance in favor of water_grid_seal frame_002. Baseline manatee separation was confirmed in actual Release preview; no need to reproduce that defect. Death remains sampled asset capability, not verified runtime Death. Performance gates disabled, no performance PASS or full-route acceptance. Reviewer is Codex, not user sign-off.
